articles.title: Spanish ‘soonicorn’ Multiverse Computing releases free compressed AI model
articles.summary: Spanish startup Multiverse Computing has released a new version of its HyperNova 60B model on Hugging Face that, it says, bests Mistral's model.

articles.title: Uber engineers built an AI version of their boss
articles.summary: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said the company’s employees have gone all in on AI, going so far as to build a chatbot of him that they use to practice their pitches.

articles.title: Anthropic won’t budge as Pentagon escalates AI dispute
articles.summary: The Pentagon has given Anthropic until Friday to loosen AI guardrails or face potential penalties, escalating a high-stakes dispute that raises questions about government leverage, vendor dependence, and investor confidence in defense tech.

articles.title: Google adds a way to create automated workflows to Opal
articles.summary: The company said that a new agent being introduced in Opal will allow users to create mini-apps that can let them plan and execute tasks using text prompts.

articles.title: OpenAI COO says ‘we have not yet really seen AI penetrate enterprise business processes’
articles.summary: There is a lot of talk around AI agents taking over business processes and claiming that "SaaS is dead." While these predictions have moved SaaS stocks at times, they haven't really come true.

articles.title: Music generator ProducerAI joins Google Labs
articles.summary: Wyclef Jean used Google's AI music tools on his new song "Back in Abu Dhabi."

articles.title: Meta strikes up to $100B AMD chip deal as it chases ‘personal superintelligence’
articles.summary: Meta is buying billions of dollars in AMD AI chips in a multiyear deal tied to a 160 million-share warrant, deepening its push to diversify beyond Nvidia and expand data center capacity.

articles.title: Oura launches a proprietary AI model focused on women’s health
articles.summary: The model supports questions spanning the full reproductive health spectrum, from early menstrual cycles through menopause.

articles.title: Final 4 days to save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
articles.summary: Just 4 days left before savings of up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass end on February 27 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Register to save at one of the most anticipated tech events of the year.

articles.title: Anthropic launches new push for enterprise agents with plug-ins for finance, engineering, and design
articles.summary: It's a major opportunity to grow Anthropic’s enterprise client base — and a significant threat to SaaS products currently performing those functions.

articles.title: New Relic launches new AI agent platform and OpenTelemetry tools
articles.summary: New Relic is giving enterprises more observability tools, letting them create and manage AI agents, and better integrate OTel data streams.

articles.title: Nimble raises $47M to give AI agents access to real-time web data
articles.summary: Nimble uses AI agents to search the web, verify and validate the results, and then clean and structure the information into neat tables that can then be queried like a database.

articles.title: Canva acquires startups working on animation and marketing
articles.summary: With the new acquisitions, the company wants to bolster its position as a marketing solution by potentially adding video creation and more granular measurement.

articles.title: A Meta AI security researcher said an OpenClaw agent ran amok on her inbox
articles.summary: The viral X post from an AI security researcher reads like satire. But it's really a word of warning about what can go wrong when handing tasks to an AI agent.

articles.title: With AI, investor loyalty is (almost) dead: At least a dozen OpenAI VCs now also back Anthropic
articles.summary: While some dual investors are understandable, others were more shocking, and signal the disregard of a longstanding ethical conflict-of-interest rule.

articles.title: Anthropic accuses Chinese AI labs of mining Claude as US debates AI chip exports
articles.summary: Anthropic accuses DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax of using 24,000 fake accounts to distill Claude’s AI capabilities, as U.S. officials debate export controls aimed at slowing China’s AI progress.

articles.title: Google’s Cloud AI leads on the three frontiers of model capability
articles.summary: AI models are pushing against three frontiers at once: raw intelligence, response time, and a third quality you might call "extensibility."

articles.title: OpenAI calls in the consultants for its enterprise push
articles.summary: OpenAI is partnering with four consulting giants in an effort to see more adoption of its OpenAI Frontier AI agent platform.

articles.title: Guide Labs debuts a new kind of interpretable LLM
articles.summary: The company open sourced an 8-billion-parameter LLM, Steerling-8B, trained with a new architecture designed to make its actions easily interpretable.

articles.title: Particle’s AI news app listens to podcasts for interesting clips so you you don’t have to
articles.summary: AI news app Particle can now pull in key moments from podcasts, letting readers instantly play short, relevant clips alongside related stories.

articles.title: Mississippi's governor calls data center moratoria "civilizational suicide"
articles.summary: Governor Tate Reeves blames data center pushback on "far left," but issue remains bipartisan

articles.title: Denver plans data center moratorium, as Senator Bernie Sanders calls for nationwide pause
articles.summary: Currently, only the CoreSite DE3 facility is permitted and under construction in the city

articles.title: EQT-backed Scale acquires powered land for data centers company Reload
articles.summary: Financial terms were not disclosed

articles.title: Nokia and AWS set up agentic AI powered network slice
articles.summary: Carried out a trial with telcos Du and Orange

articles.title: Google to develop 'clean energy' colocated data center in Wilbarger County, Texas
articles.summary: Set to be powered by onsite 'clean energy' developed by AES

articles.title: Kentucky House proposes new rate class for large load data centers
articles.summary: Would apply to data centers with a capacity exceeding 100MW

articles.title: Vantage Towers pairs with Elisa Industriq’s Gridle to bolster telecoms infrastructure resiliency in Spain
articles.summary: The partnership will see virtual power plants deployed on Vantage Towers’ infrastructure

articles.title: Nexalus picks Alps Alpine to manufacture liquid cooling kit for data centers
articles.summary: Systems will be built at factory in County Cork, Ireland

articles.title: Indian cloud provider NxtGen AI adopts diamond-cooled GPU servers
articles.summary: Company partners with Akash Systems for H200 servers

articles.title: US President Trump sets new global tariff of 10 percent, after Supreme Court setback
articles.summary: Trump had threatened 15 percent, which could still happen

articles.title: North America data center report: Year-end 2025
articles.summary: The data center sector shifts into hyperdrive.

articles.title: Google announces first data center in Minnesota
articles.summary: Partners with Xcel Energy on the project in Pine Island

articles.title: US Air Force could allow data centers to be built on Alaska bases
articles.summary: Responses to the Request for Information due by March 13

articles.title: Plan to convert former psychiatric hospital near Philadelphia into data center could be blocked
articles.summary: Local planning commission not in favor of scheme

articles.title: DCD>Studio: Exploring the evolution of power dynamics with Vandana Singh, Schneider Electric
articles.summary: Claire Fletcher speaks with Vandana Singh of Schneider Electric on AI-driven power dynamics, rising rack densities, energy demand growth, and how electrification, automation, and digitization enable efficient, sustainable data centers.

articles.title: Echelon Data Centres secures €1.7bn loan from Morgan Stanley
articles.summary: Plans to grow across Europe

articles.title: Lenders committed $121bn to US data center construction in 2025
articles.summary: Virginia continues fall-off in data center investment

articles.title: Brookfield's Radiant acquires Ori Industries for combined AI cloud platform
articles.summary: Backed by the $10 billion Brookfield Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Fund

articles.title: SWI invests in German cloud provider Polarise
articles.summary: Acquired company to support AIOnX

articles.title: Finland's YIT plans data center in Kontiolahti
articles.summary: Construction company looks to develop in east of country

articles.title: Rivian partners with EnergyHub on managed EV charging
articles.summary: Rivian drivers will be able to participate in passive and active managed utility charging programs, company officials told Utility Dive.

articles.title: Dominion Energy details its $65B, 5-year spending plan
articles.summary: Data center demand is driving load forecasts and robust capital spending plans as Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind nears the finish line, company executives said Monday.

articles.title: ConEd eyes $38B in capital spending through 2030
articles.summary: The downstate New York utility company sees robust demand growth from electric vehicles and buildings amid heightened reliability challenges and affordability concerns.

articles.title: Entergy Texas seeks gas generation to meet 1 GW of new demand
articles.summary: The utility issued a request for proposals seeking gas-fired resources capable of being online by 2032 to meet “significant industrial and residential growth.”

articles.title: PJM proposes behind-the-meter reforms in data center colocation effort
articles.summary: The planned reform threatens the economic viability of new combined heat and power generation at industrial facilities in the PJM Interconnection, according to trade groups.

articles.title: The false promise of cheap and reliable coal
articles.summary: Colorado’s youngest coal-fired generating unit will not produce power, or savings, anytime soon. The problems with Comanche Unit 3 highlight the hazards of relying on coal, write clean energy advocates Anna Adamsson and Leslie Glustrom.

articles.title: Natural gas equipment bottleneck is easing, analysts say
articles.summary: Manufacturers GE Vernova, Siemens and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries “have all announced significant capacity expansions since the start of last year,” said Wood Mackenzie’s vice chair of Americas, Ed Crooks.

articles.title: What the Supreme Court tariff ruling means for construction
articles.summary: The court decision could drive a modest reduction in price escalation for electrical systems and fixtures, but materials-specific tariffs on steel, aluminum and copper products remain in place, experts said.

articles.title: The electricity paradox: Driving affordability means infrastructure investment
articles.summary: Energy abundance, AI competitiveness and consumer affordability are not in conflict, but the power sector needs to show that growth can lower bills, not raise them, write Ray Gifford and Matt Larson from Wilkinson Barker Knauer.

articles.title: PPL spending plan jumps 15%, to $23B, on transmission, grid hardening
articles.summary: A PPL-Blackstone Infrastructure joint venture is in talks with hyperscalers to supply their data centers with generation, including options that could be built quickly, a company official said.

articles.title: Eagles and Newcleo team up for LFR technology demonstrator
articles.summary: The Eagles Consortium has signed a collaboration agreement with France-based innovative reactor developer Newcleo to work together on the realisation of the LEANDREA lead-cooled small modular reactor technology demonstrator at Mol in Belgium.

articles.title: Cold testing of third Sanmen unit completed
articles.summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at unit 3 of the Sanmen nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: India’s Rajasthan unit 7 reaches full power
articles.summary: Rajasthan nuclear power plant’s unit 7 is the third of sixteen 700 MW Indian-designed pressurised heavy water reactors being built in the country.

articles.title: Solstice plans expansion of US conversion facility
articles.summary: Solstice Advanced Materials announced that its Metropolis Works plant in Illinois - the USA's only domestic uranium conversion facility - is expected to produce more than 10,000 tonnes of uranium hexafluoride in 2026, which represents about a 20% increase from its planned output in 2024.

articles.title: EDF to seek approval for new acoustic fish deterrent system
articles.summary: Initial trials show an acoustic fish deterrent system that would use underwater ultrasound technology to keep fish away from Hinkley Point C's water intake system have been effective, EDF has said.

articles.title: Assessment of proposed Norwegian SMR plant to begin
articles.summary: The Norwegian government has given Norsk Kjernekraft approval to begin work on an impact assessment for a nuclear power plant in Aure and Heim municipalities, the first step in the licensing process for nuclear power in Norway.

articles.title: US campaign puts case for disposal, not reprocessing, of used fuel
articles.summary: The Nuclear Scaling Initiative’s Scale What Works campaign says that direct disposal of used nuclear fuel in the US is the "safest, most secure and least expensive pathway for the country" as nuclear energy capacity is expanded.

articles.title: Safety review completed at South African research reactor
articles.summary: A team of International Atomic Energy Agency experts has outlined areas of good performance, and areas for strengthening South Africa's Safari-1 research reactor's ageing management programme.

articles.title: Study examines benefits of Pallas to future power plant construction
articles.summary: The knowledge and expertise gained in the Netherlands from the construction of the Pallas research reactor reduces the risk of delays in future nuclear power plant construction thanks to experience with permits, documentation, and supply chain qualification, according to a study by SEO Economic Research.

articles.title: Final Investment Decision taken for Romanian SMR project
articles.summary: The shareholders of Romanian nuclear operator Nuclearelectrica have approved the Final Investment Decision for the small modular reactor project in Doicești.

articles.title: Nuclear central in France's latest energy strategy
articles.summary: The French government has published the third Multiannual Energy Programme, setting out the country's energy strategy to address the challenges of energy consumption and production over the period 2026-2035. It calls for the construction of six new reactors and the extended operation of the country's existing nuclear fleet.

articles.title: OPG and Port Hope to collaborate on 10 GW new nuclear plan
articles.summary: Ontario Power Generation and the Municipality of Port Hope are to work together on a new nuclear power plant at the Wesleyville site in Canada - which has the potential to host as much as 10 GW of capacity.

articles.title: Bannerman partners with CNNC for Namibian uranium project
articles.summary: Australia-based Bannerman Energy has signed a strategic financing and joint venture agreement with China's CNNC Overseas Limited, paving the way for debt-free construction of its Etango uranium project in Namibia.

articles.title: Taipingling 1 connected to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Taipingling nuclear power plant has begun supplying electricity to the grid for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: First unit at San'ao plant starts up
articles.summary: Unit 1 at the San'ao nuclear power plant has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The site in Zhejiang province will eventually host six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors.

articles.title: Tarapur 1 returns to service after refurbishment
articles.summary: India's oldest commercial nuclear power plant has returned to service after a long-term outage for refurbishment and life-extension work.

articles.title: Defuelling of German plant completed
articles.summary: All the used nuclear fuel assemblies in the storage pool at the Brokdorf nuclear power plant have been transferred to an on-site interim storage facility, allowing the plant to move into the second phase of its decommissioning, PreussenElektra announced.

articles.title: US regulator issues licence for TRISO-X fuel facility
articles.summary: The X-energy, LLC subsidiary is now authorised for the commercial fabrication of tristructural isotropic - or TRISO - fuel for advanced nuclear reactors at a facility that is currently under construction in Tennessee, marking the first-ever US approval of a category II fuel fabrication facility.

articles.title: Construction of Steady Energy pilot plant begins
articles.summary: Finnish small modular reactor developer Steady Energy has poured the first concrete for a full-scale, non-nuclear pilot of its LDR‑50 small modular reactor for district heating at the decommissioned Salmisaari B coal-fired power station in central Helsinki.

articles.title: Tripartite agreement to advance nuclear energy in Africa
articles.summary: The OECD Nuclear Energy Agency, the African Union and the African Commission on Nuclear Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to cooperate in support of peaceful applications of nuclear science and technology for socio-economic development across Africa.
